shape.text: The dump happens before the settings change
shape.evidence: "## 3. Dump the data" precedes "## 6. Point settings at Postgres"; the dump happens before the settings change.
"python manage.py migrate"; every step (precheck, backup, dump, driver, role/db, settings, schema, load, verify) has an explicit command.

"Once the counts match and a login works, delete `dump.json` (it contains password hashes and any other sensitive dev data in plaintext JSON) and remove the SQLite settings block."; final line is post-verification cleanup, not the verification step itself (step 9, verify, ends two sections earlier).
